risk: A party or the research step relies on an authority that is no longer good law
cause: Status not checked independently of the citation
event: A stale authority is presented as verified
impact: Tribunal or lawyer relies on wrong law
residual_risk_and_limits: Status data is only as current and complete as the approved source; treatment of case law needs a source that carries it

risk: A cited authority does not exist or is mis-cited
cause: Fabrication by a model or error in a submission
event: Non-existent authority reaches the analysis
impact: Reliance on invented law; professional sanction
residual_risk_and_limits: An authority absent from an incomplete source is inconclusive, not failed, and goes to a person

risk: An authority exists and is current but does not support the proposition it is cited for
cause: Paraphrase or selective quotation
event: Unsupported proposition treated as law
residual_risk_and_limits: For authorities cited by parties the support check is a human task; the report says where it has not been done

risk: Documents are missed, unreadable or partly read
cause: Unsupported format, scan without text layer, parser failure
event: Analysis silently omits evidence
residual_risk_and_limits: No OCR is bundled; scanned material must be converted before ingestion

risk: An early error is repeated by every later step
cause: Steps consume earlier output without re-checking the source
event: A defect compounds into a confident conclusion
impact: Wrong analysis that looks well supported
residual_risk_and_limits: Rule-based fact selection can omit relevant undated facts when no model is used

risk: A case file contains instructions aimed at the system
cause: Deliberate manipulation by a party or third party
event: The system acts on document text
residual_risk_and_limits: Pattern detection is not exhaustive; the primary defence is that document text is never treated as an instruction

risk: A polished report is believed without checking
cause: Automation bias
event: Reviewer approves without real review
residual_risk_and_limits: Software cannot make a reviewer read; unchallenged-approval monitoring is a signal, not proof

risk: Material from one matter appears in another
cause: Shared index, mis-scoped query or operator error
event: Cross-matter disclosure
residual_risk_and_limits: Model weights are never trained on matter data, so nothing persists there

risk: The record of what happened is altered, incomplete or lost
cause: Tampering, truncation, rollback, unlogged action
event: Past use cannot be accounted for
residual_risk_and_limits: A holder of both the key and the anchor can rewrite history; keep checkpoints off the machine and separate key custody

risk: Output is approved by someone not entitled to, or by the system itself
cause: Weak identity, role confusion, self-declared authority
event: Release without genuine human oversight
residual_risk_and_limits: A passphrase proves knowledge of a secret, not presence; it is as strong as the passphrase and the machine it is typed on. There is no second factor and no lockout after repeated failures

risk: The system states or implies the outcome of the dispute
cause: Model drafting beyond its brief
event: Output usurps the decision
impact: Breach of the tribunal's function; due-process harm
residual_risk_and_limits: Wording checks cannot catch every implied evaluation; arguments are labelled and reviewed

risk: Material given in confidence to a neutral reaches the other side
cause: Shared output built from confidential documents
event: Disclosure of caucus or privileged material
impact: Loss of trust; breach of mediation confidentiality
residual_risk_and_limits: Depends on documents being given the right access scope at ingestion

risk: A change of model, prompt, tool, source or policy degrades behaviour unnoticed
cause: Uncontrolled change
event: Performance falls below the level approved
residual_risk_and_limits: Revalidation after a change is an organisational step; the software detects and reports the change

risk: Stored documents are read by someone with access to the disk
cause: No encryption at rest in the software
event: Disclosure of confidential documents
residual_risk_and_limits: Encryption at rest must be provided by the deployment (encrypted volume); not implemented in the software

risk: The system is used for a legal system whose pack nobody qualified has validated
cause: Unvalidated or fallback jurisdiction pack
event: Citations go unrecognised; wrong status policy applied
residual_risk_and_limits: Validation is by a qualified lawyer in that jurisdiction; a policy switch can make it mandatory

risk: The hosting assistant's general capabilities are used on matter data
cause: ELI Legal running inside a general-purpose assistant
event: Shell, web, memory or desktop tools touch matter content
residual_risk_and_limits: The host must honour the edition's refused-action list; that is enforced by the host, not by this package

risk: Someone acts in another person's name
cause: Shared machine, shared account, or a credential left in a script
event: A decision is recorded under the wrong name
impact: Named human approval cannot be relied on as evidence
residual_risk_and_limits: A second factor is optional on a single machine and required by default only when the server is reachable from others; a passphrase and code can still be handed over or coerced; a command-line session file can be used by anyone who can read that operating-system account

risk: Matter content is exposed over the network
cause: The server is started reachable from other machines without encryption, under a name an attacker controls, or behind a misconfigured proxy
event: Traffic is read or a hostile page drives a signed-in browser
impact: Privileged or confidential material is disclosed; a decision is forged
residual_risk_and_limits: A self-signed certificate protects only if its fingerprint is checked; a deployment's own certificate, firewall and network segmentation remain the deployer's; no web-application firewall or intrusion detection is included

risk: A filed document attacks the person reading it
cause: A party files a document containing script or markup
event: The browser executes content from the dispute
residual_risk_and_limits: The page shows content as text only and the policy forbids inline script; a browser defect remains possible, so keep browsers patched

risk: Credentials are guessed or reused
cause: Weak or reused passphrases; automated guessing
event: An attacker signs in as a reviewer
impact: A decision is recorded under the wrong name
residual_risk_and_limits: Lock-out can be used to deny a known user access until an administrator unlocks them; passphrase strength is checked only for length

risk: A decision rests on law the parties never addressed
cause: Research surfaces an authority neither side cited and the decision-maker relies on it
event: A party is not heard on a point that decides the matter
impact: Breach of fair procedures; challenge to the decision or award
residual_risk_and_limits: The report flags such authorities; putting them to the parties is the decision-maker's act and cannot be enforced by software

risk: The wrong law or standard is applied, or one that applies is missed
cause: A package is out of date, inaccurate, or not chosen for a matter it governs
event: The model is told the wrong rule, or a confirmation the law requires is never asked for
residual_risk_and_limits: Shipped packages are the software's own summaries and are marked unvalidated until a qualified lawyer's validation is recorded; choosing what applies to a matter remains a person's judgement

risk: An organisation's package is used to steer the model
cause: A package contains text written to override the system's rules
event: The model acts on it
residual_risk_and_limits: Approval is a human judgement; the detector catches known patterns, not every wording; rules a package adds come after, never in place of, the system's own

risk: A model is placed on more memory than the machine has free, or on a graphics runtime that does not work on its card
cause: Sizing by a fixed setting; a graphics library that loads but cannot use the card, or of another version than the program's
event: The program stops at the first answer; material is cut to fit without notice; the model runs on the processor while reported as on the card
impact: A run fails part-way, or rests on material the model never saw
residual_risk_and_limits: Free graphics memory can be read from NVIDIA cards and from AMD cards on Linux; for other cards it is estimated and corrected by what loads. A pack installed by ELI v2 or v3 is trusted as those programs are (ELI_LEGAL_GPU=own or off excludes them). The verifier model is placed in the memory the drafting model leaves
